answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake a refundable deposit that is slashed on proven misbehavior, and publish a public reputation signal tied to attested work history. Creating a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand deposits, while honest agents keep theirs. The zenith of this design is a jade-clear ledger: every stake, attestation, and slash is visible, so a newcomer can check whether an identity earned its standing or merely bought a fresh face.
